question: Should local Debug builds now default to the release app identity, with side-by-side dev identity available only through `-DevBuild` or `-Dev`?
rationale: Current main intentionally made Debug builds dev-identity by default for side-by-side safety, and this PR deliberately reverses that default while adding new launch/build switches.

options.title: Accept opt-in dev identity after the WinApp fix
options.body: Merge the default flip once the dev WinApp path uses a matching manifest or the unsupported hint is removed.

options.title: Keep Debug dev-by-default
options.body: Preserve the current side-by-side Debug behavior and narrow this PR to marker validation or documentation only.

options.title: Require a stricter migration plan
options.body: Hold the PR until docs and proof cover existing developer workflows that depend on Debug using dev identity by default.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in dev identity after the WinApp fix
recommendation.body: Merge the default flip once the dev WinApp path uses a matching manifest or the unsupported hint is removed.

likelyOwner.reason: The default being changed was introduced as part of karkarl's side-by-side identity feature work.
